description: GRC MouseTrap: Reports whether a Windows system or Wine environment is vulnerable to the historical WMF/MICE metafile execution issue.
notes: GRC does not publish a static SHA-256 checksum for this download. The manifest omits hash rather than inventing a value.
Legacy vulnerability diagnostic from 2006. Modern Windows should be assessed using current patch and security tools.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to read the published Last Updated date for MouseTrap.' }
